questions.stem: Who among the following is the eldest?

The one likes cherry is just younger to Anko. The difference between Viraj’s and the one who likes cherry is 24 years. The one who likes banana was born in an even year. The one who likes orange is younger to the one who likes grapes both in odd number of years. Monika is younger than Viraj.
